item.title: Transform Job Posts Into Interview Questions 🔍 • Identify key skills in the job post. • Create questions around each skill. • Prepare answers using STAR method. • Practice with a friend or mentor. • Use: “I demonstrated X by doing Y.” How can you tailor your interview prep using job posts more effectively? #interview #careeradvice #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
